# Install packes
```{r}
# Set up renv for package management
if (!requireNamespace("renv", quietly = TRUE)) {
    install.packages("renv")
} else {
    message("renv is already installed.")
}

# Load the renv package
library(renv)

# Check if renv is already active, activate if not
if (!renv::status()$synchronized) {
    renv::activate()
}

# To restore the environment (for a collaborator)
renv::restore()

# Load the required libraries
library(terra)
library(here)
library(tidyterra)
```

# Load the processed data data
```{r}
# Define the base data directory
data_dir <- here("Data", "processed")

# List of subdirectories containing geospatial data
folders <- c("Adm_boundaries", "DEM", "Facilities", "Flood_extents", 
             "Landcover", "OSM_roads", "Rainfall_estimation", 
             "water_lines", "Worldpop_density", "Worldpop_dev_indicators")

# Loop through each folder to load files
for (folder in folders) {
  folder_path <- file.path(data_dir, folder)
  
  # List all files in the folder
  files <- list.files(folder_path, full.names = TRUE, recursive = TRUE)
  
  # Load vector files (e.g., .shp, .geojson, .gpkg)
  vector_files <- files[grepl("\\.(shp|geojson|gpkg)$", files, ignore.case = TRUE)]
  if (length(vector_files) == 1) {
    assign(folder, vect(vector_files[[1]]), envir = .GlobalEnv)
    print(paste("Loaded single vector data into", folder))
  } else if (length(vector_files) > 1) {
    assign(folder, lapply(vector_files, vect), envir = .GlobalEnv)
    print(paste("Loaded multiple vector data into", folder, "as a list"))
  }
  
  # Load raster files (e.g., .tif, .vrt)
  raster_files <- files[grepl("\\.(tif|vrt)$", files, ignore.case = TRUE)]
  if (length(raster_files) == 1) {
    assign(folder, rast(raster_files[[1]]), envir = .GlobalEnv)
    print(paste("Loaded single raster data into", folder))
  } else if (length(raster_files) > 1) {
    assign(folder, lapply(raster_files, rast), envir = .GlobalEnv)
    print(paste("Loaded multiple raster data into", folder, "as a list"))
  }
}

# Remove redundant temporary objects
rm(files, vector_files, raster_files, folder_path, folder, data_dir, folders)
```
